=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text nomore "No more"
text b1 " bottle"
text bn " bottles"
text wall " of beer on the wall\n"
text beer " of beer\n"
text take "Take one down, pass it around\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
fn bottles n ulong to void
if eq n 0
emit nomore
else
emitu n
end
if eq n 1
emit b1
else
emit bn
end
end
fn main to int
for i ulong 99
n = sub 99 i
bottles n
emit wall
bottles n
emit beer
emit take
bottles sub n 1
emit wall
if lt i 98
emit nl
end
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}

99 bottles of beer
Take one down, pass it around
98 bottles of beer on the wall

98 bottles of beer
Take one down, pass it around

97 bottles of beer on the wall
97 bottles of beer
Take one down, pass it around
96 bottles of beer on the wall

...
2 bottles of beer
Take one down, pass it around
1 bottle of beer on the wall

1 bottle of beer on the wall
1 bottle of beer
Take one down, pass it around
No more bottles of beer on the wall
</pre>
